items.headline: Bitcoin ETFs See $486M Inflows in 2 Days: Could This Be the Best Week Since January?
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs pull in $486.85M in two days, putting a $1B week within reach as CryptoQuant flags a bullish spot demand signal.

items.headline: Shares of crypto-related companies are trading higher alongside a rise in Bitcoin prices as Treasury yields decline, improving risk appetite and supporting demand for higher-risk assets. Sentiment is also supported by President Trump’s planned meeting with cryptocurrency executives at the White House, as U.S. financial regulators prepare to advance a framework for certain digital assets.
Riot’s Relative Strength Stands Out in a Brutal Bitcoin Mining Earnings Season
items.summary: Bitcoin mining stocks diverge: Riot shines with AI/HPC optionality, while Mara and Galaxy miss earnings. Relative strength highlights selective market.

items.headline: Shares of crypto-linked companies are trading higher amid a rise in Bitcoin after President Trump urged Congress to pass the Clarity Act and said the Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chair Michael Selig is working to bring Hyperliquid to the U.S.
StablecoinX shares are trading higher after the company launched its flagship infrastructure software platform, StablecoinX Harness.
Deere, Coinbase Global, Nordson And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Wednesday
items.summary: Dow Jones down 300 points, Deere & Co shares up 7.9% after beating earnings expectations. SCTX, SCSC, BTBT, MRVI, HIVE, AHG, TEM, MARA, LB also gain.
